businesses.business: Building materials distribution and wood products manufacturing

offering_description.value: The company supplies lumber, panels and other building materials to lumber dealers, home improvement retailers and industrial customers through its wholesale distribution network. It also manufactures engineered wood products, plywood and lumber for sale through its own distribution business and independent wholesalers and dealers.

primary_products.value: Lumber; plywood and other structural panels; engineered wood products including I-joists and laminated veneer lumber; siding; decking

primary_services.value: Wholesale building materials distribution and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: Lumberyards, building materials dealers, home improvement retailers, specialty distributors and industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: Residential construction; home repair and remodeling; commercial construction; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wholesale purchases of building materials and sales of company-manufactured engineered wood, plywood and lumber

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources building materials from manufacturers and its own mills for dealers, home centers and industrial customers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes logs and veneer into engineered wood, plywood and lumber for wholesalers and dealers

geography_served.value: North America: Nationwide U.S. distribution and wood product sales in the United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Wholesale building materials distribution and manufacturing of engineered wood, plywood and lumber

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Wholesale sales to lumberyards, home improvement chains and industrial accounts; distributors / dealers: Independent wholesalers and lumber dealers that resell wood products to builders and contractors; third-party retail: Home improvement centers that resell building materials to contractors and consumers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Wood mills and warehouses face EPA and state environmental requirements and OSHA workplace safety rules
